about: A Java library for creating, editing and reading PDF files.

prs.title: Text from tagged PDFs keeps its line breaks
prs.broken: Extracting text from a tagged PDF, such as LibreOffice makes by default, ran every line together into one long line.
prs.changed: Line breaks between separately tagged parts of the page are now kept.
prs.matters: Text pulled from these PDFs reads the way it looks on the page.
